news.headline: Somalia: We would not have recovered without the international community
news.summary: Somalia continues to face al-Shabab rebellion and political friction, leading officials to urge international support.

news.headline: Israel kills senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza strike
news.summary: The Israeli military said on Sunday its forces had killed a senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza. The militant group confirmed the death of Samir Abu Younis, the commander of its Rafah brigade, adding that he played a prominent role in planning the October 7, 2023 attacks.
